item.title: Together AI expands fine-tuning service with more models, live metrics, and finer controls
item.description: Together Fine-Tuning adds the latest open-weight models, live experiment tracking, Expert LoRA, early stopping, tokenized dataset previews, pre-flight validation, and lower training prices on selected models.

item.title: Introducing preemptible compute: the same compute, half the price
item.description: Together GPU Clusters now supports preemptible compute: the same GPU capacity at a flat 50% of the on-demand rate, with a five-minute drain window.

item.title: To Infinity and Beyond: ThunderKittens Now on NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72!
item.description: We ported ThunderKittens to NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72 and rebuilt our NVFP4 GEMM around the new hardware, taking it from 42% of roofline to over 22 PFLOPS — competitive with cuBLAS and CuTe DSL. Here is what changed in the ISA and how we used it.

item.title: The Open Source AI Stack
item.description: A deep dive into the open model AI stack — model, inference, gateways and routers, harness, and tools — and how keeping each layer independent lets you swap in a new open model in minutes instead of rebuilding your workflow.
